name: What Are the Most Common Kitchen Remodel Mistakes?

mainEntity.name: What are the most common mistakes homeowners make during a kitchen remodel?
mainEntity.text: What are the most common mistakes homeowners make during a kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The biggest kitchen remodel mistakes usually come from rushing the planning stage. Homeowners often focus on appearance first and only later realize the layout does not support the way they cook and store things. Another common mistake is failing to define the exact scope before construction starts, which leads to change orders and budget drift. In Los Angeles County, overlooking permit needs or assuming the contractor will handle every approval detail can also cause delays. Many people underestimate how disruptive it is to live without a functioning kitchen for weeks. To avoid problems, finalize the layout, confirm appliance dimensions, choose key materials early, and ask for a written timeline and payment schedule. Good planning reduces stress, avoids rework, and helps the finished kitchen feel intentional rather than improvised.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common mistakes include starting without a clear scope, choosing finishes before the layout is finalized, underestimating storage needs, ignoring permit requirements, and not planning for temporary kitchen use. Poor communication and too many late changes also cause delays and extra cost.
